## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Host tests pass.
- [ ] Pico 2 firmware builds.
- [ ] Hardware behavior was tested, or the reason it could not be tested is stated.
- [ ] Protocol and documentation were updated if behavior changed.

## Hardware and safety

State the board, wiring, GPIO, and load used for testing. Do not include a
live mains connection in test evidence. Security issues should follow
SECURITY.md instead of this pull request.
